The '''Great Cataclysm''' was a hypothesized event that [[Geology|geologist]] [[Adari Vaal]] believed might have occurred in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh's]] distant past. Vaal's comparison of minerals from the far-flung continents of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]] and [[Alanciar]] led her to believe that some massive event cut the two lands off from each other.
